subject: Office revenue and finance benches, 2026-10-23

items.source: QuickBooks Online, company Eden Partner Group, Profit and Loss report, 2026-10-01 to 2026-10-23, line 'Total Income' (Income section only; excludes Other Income). The MCP P&L tool has no cash/accrual switch, so state the basis your own run shows.

items.label: EPG revenue, year to date
items.source: QuickBooks Online, company Eden Partner Group, Profit and Loss report, 2026-01-01 to 2026-10-23, line 'Total Income' (Income section only; excludes Other Income such as Owner Compensation). Same basis caveat as month to date.

items.label: EPG open AR, total
items.source: QuickBooks Online, company Eden Partner Group, A/R Aging Summary as of 2026-10-23, report total across all customers and all buckets (accrual report; no cash version exists).

items.source: QuickBooks Online, company Eden Partner Group, A/R Aging Summary as of 2026-10-23, sum of the 31-60, 61-90 and 91+ day buckets across all customers.

items.source: QuickBooks Online, company Eden Partner Group, A/P Aging Summary as of 2026-10-23, report total across all vendors and all buckets (accrual report).

items.source: QuickBooks Online, company Eden Partner Group, Balance Sheet, cash basis, as of 2026-10-23, line 'Bank Accounts' (sum of the bank accounts; excludes Other Current Assets, loans to others and other assets). Rounded to whole dollars.
